name: InterContinental Lhasa Paradise
positioning: Tibetan-style city hotel in Lhasa, billed as the highest-altitude InterContinental hotel in the world, with in-room oxygen for the altitude
best_for: Travelers exploring Lhasa's palaces and temples who want help adjusting to the altitude
Guests who want a concierge to guide them to local sights and authentic Lhasa dining

facts.text: The hotel bills itself as the highest-altitude InterContinental hotel in the world.
Rooms are designed in Tibetan style, with a digital entertainment system, a spacious bathroom and internet access.
Rooms have in-room central oxygen and access to humidifiers to help guests stay comfortable at high altitude.
The lobby bar serves a Tibetan-style afternoon tea that blends British and Tibetan flavors, including highland barley Napoleons and highland barley tiramisu.
Feast All Day Dining serves Western, Chinese, Tibetan and Asian dishes, with buffet and a la carte service.
The Chief Concierge, a Golden Key member, guides guests to nearby attractions and suggests authentic Lhasa dining and experiences.
The hotel is at No.1 Jiangsu Avenue in Lhasa.
The hotel has seven banquet halls of different sizes, the largest a grand banquet hall that holds 1,000 people.
Children's activities are offered on site.
Wi-Fi is free, and parking is complimentary for hotel guests.

highlights.text: Billed as the highest-altitude InterContinental hotel in the world.
In-room central oxygen and humidifiers help guests stay comfortable at high altitude.
Rooms are designed in Tibetan style, with spacious bathrooms.
A Golden Key Chief Concierge guides guests to nearby attractions and suggests authentic Lhasa dining and experiences.
A Tibetan-style afternoon tea in the lobby bar blends British and Tibetan flavors, with highland barley Napoleons and tiramisu.

considerations.text: The Potala Palace is about 8.1 kilometers from the hotel, and Jokhang Temple about 6.6 kilometers.
The hotel does not have a pool.
Lhasa Gonggar Airport is approximately 70 kilometers from the hotel.
